description: Read, unread, flags and Gmail's Important marker that reach the mail server and say whether they did, and read receipts through Thunderbird's own receipt sender.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Mark messages read or unread, flagged or not, and wait for the IMAP server to confirm. wholeConversation: for Gmail, marking read takes in the conversation's other unread messages in the same folder. Resolves to {changed, missing, conversation, server}.

functions.name: important
functions.description: Add or remove Gmail's Important marker on one message. Resolves to {done, already, reason}.

functions.name: isImportant
functions.description: Whether each Gmail message has Gmail's Important marker, from Thunderbird's copy of the Important folder. Resolves to {id: true or false}; other accounts are left out. Changes nothing.

functions.name: sentImportant
functions.description: After sending with high importance from a Gmail account, add Gmail's Important marker to the copy in Sent Mail. Resolves to {done, already, reason}.

functions.name: needsReceipt
functions.description: Whether a read receipt may be due: yes (the header asked), maybe (only the full header can say), or an empty string. Changes nothing.

functions.name: receipt
functions.description: Handle a message's read receipt by Thunderbird's receipt settings. Resolves to {state}: none, handled, or ask (then call receiptAnswer).

functions.name: receiptAnswer
functions.description: Send, or do not send, a read receipt Thunderbird asked about. Resolves to {done}.
